posts.post: The island answers a clap, a broken take
posts.what: A fixed low view from behind wooden planks and cattails at the pond: the friends stand far off by the shore, a sheep shifts and a scrap of paper flutters in the tree, then the picture fades to black; nothing visible answers a clap, and the meant change (the island's traced echo, heard from that spot) can only be carried by the soundtrack.
posts.recipe: static hidden ear, traced echo on the soundtrack, failed take
posts.shared: a new way of sensing the island (optics there, acoustics here)
